title: Induced morphism and ordinary module comparison for a flat blowup square
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $e:T\to S$, $g:Y\to T$, and $j:Y\to X$ be morphisms of schemes with $f\circ j=e\circ g$ [def-pc-scheme], and assume $e$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be a quasi-coherent ideal [pqf-def-coherent], and put $\mathcal I_T=\mathcal I\mathcal O_T$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Write $b:B=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}S\to S$ and $b_T:B_T=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I_T}T\to T$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Let $\beta:B_T\to B$ be the composite of the canonical flat blowup base-change map with its projection to $B$ [def-nagata-blowup-flat-base-change-map]. Set $P=X\times_SB$, $Q=Y\times_TB_T$, with projections $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to B$, $r:Q\to Y$, and $s:Q\to B_T$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $u:Q\to P$ to be the unique induced morphism with $p\circ u=j\circ r$ and $q\circ u=\beta\circ s$. For every sheaf of modules $\mathcal F$ on $X$, define the ordinary-pullback comparison $\gamma:u^*p^*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\sim}r^*j^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] as the composite $u^*p^*\mathcal F\cong(p\circ u)^*\mathcal F=(j\circ r)^*\mathcal F\cong r^*j^*\mathcal F$ using the section-normalized composition comparisons of that pullback. These are the constructions named moduleStrictTransformFlatPullbackMap and moduleStrictTransformFlatPullbackSourceIso, respectively. No flatness of $j$, finite-type condition on $\mathcal I$, or quasi-coherence condition on $\mathcal F$ is part of this definition.
